title: ექსპერიმენტი
style: Characters are fashionable and good-looking. Natural lip movement. No subtitles, no text on screen.

clips.prompt:
15-second fast-paced cinematic sequence, vertical 9:16, realistic, 35mm film look, film grain, cold blue tones, quick cuts, no dead time.
Shot 1 (0-4s): Aerial drone shot at dusk: an isolated modern-rustic two-story wooden cabin in a foggy pine forest, a black minivan driving away. No dialogue.
Shot 2 (4-8s): Six attractive, stylish young Georgian people with lean bodies walk toward the cabin with designer backpacks. A charming lean Georgian man with curly auburn hair in a mustard knit sweater smirks and says in Georgian: "ორმოცდაათი ათასი შვიდ დღეში? საეჭვოდ კარგია."
Shot 3 (8-11s): Night, inside a stylish rustic living room with warm lamps. A black speaker on the wall crackles, and a calm, deep, slightly distorted male voice from the speaker says in Georgian: "კეთილი იყოს თქვენი მობრძანება."
Shot 4 (11-15s): Quick cuts across the six tense faces as the speaker voice continues in Georgian: "წესი პირველი: ერთ-ერთი თქვენგანი იტყუება." The last cut lands on a handsome lean young Georgian man with styled dark wavy hair and stubble in a black leather jacket, who slowly turns to stare suspiciously at a beautiful young woman with long light-brown waves and gold hoops.
Characters are fashionable and good-looking. Natural lip movement. Ambient: wind, static crackle. No subtitles, no text on screen.

lines.text: ექვსი უცნობი. შვიდი დღე. *ორმოცდაათი ათასი ლარი*.

Shot 1 (0-4s): Dark cabin hallway. A handsome lean young Georgian man with styled dark wavy hair and stubble in a black leather jacket yanks the front door handle — locked. Heavy lock clicks.
Shot 2 (4-8s): A pretty petite Georgian woman with a sleek black bob and thin gold round glasses in an olive blazer holds an empty basket and says in Georgian with panic: "ტელეფონები... ჩვენი ტელეფონები გაქრა!"
Shot 3 (8-11s): Quick close-ups, no dialogue: a fit Georgian man with a short faded haircut in a black hoodie clenches his jaw; a beautiful woman with light-brown waves exchanges a secret glance with someone off-screen.
Shot 4 (11-15s): Dim bedroom. A striking Georgian woman with sharp features and dark hair in a sleek tight bun, charcoal hoodie, sits on a bed, looks straight into the camera and says quietly in Georgian: "ერთ-ერთი ჩვენგანი იტყუება." Hard cut to black.
Characters are fashionable and good-looking. Natural lip movement. Ambient: lock clicking, wind, creaking wood. No subtitles, no text on screen.

lines.text: მათ ჯერ არ იციან, რომ ექსპერიმენტი *უკვე დაიწყო*.
